evidence.text: Master of None is an American comedy-drama web television series , which was released for streaming on November 6 , 2015 on Netflix .
Netflix released an estimated 126 original series or films in 2016 , more than any other network or cable channel .
Hee Man : Master of None is a 1985 Filipino fantasy film directed by Tony Y. Reyes
The second season consists of ten episodes and was released on May 12 , 2017 .
Netflix is an American entertainment company founded by Reed Hastings and Marc Randolph on August 29 , 1997 , in Scotts Valley , California .
